findings.title: PeakTracker discards each month's final metering window at month rollover; it never enters billed peaks
findings.claim: On the first sample of a new month PeakTracker.observe resets peaks and the open window without closing it, so the month's final metering window is never billed: with a 5 kW load only in that window, 0 of 24 month/window cells record it and the billed-equivalent max stays 1.0 kW.

evidence.contention_note: shared box, other finder seats running; count is contention-immune

perturbation.change: call self._close_window(tariff) before the month-change reset in PeakTracker.observe (harness --perturb)

findings.metric_definition: Count of (month, window_minutes) cells whose final metering window's kW ever appears in PeakTracker.peaks while tracker.month is that month; 12 months x {15,60}.
findings.phenomenon_property: Every closed metering window of a month, including the last, must be folded into that month's peaks before the month's state is reset.
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Close the open window into the old month before resetting in PeakTracker.observe and ensure _roll_month books capacity from the closed state; add a regression test with a last-window spike.

findings.title: Climate set-point surface written in degC on a Fahrenheit Home Assistant instance
findings.claim: pump_arbiter._write converts with temperature_from_c(value, state_unit(state)); a climate state has no unit_of_measurement so the conversion is identity and climate.set_temperature receives the degC number, interpreted by HA in the instance unit (degF). Space 21 degC is delivered as 21 degF (-6.1 degC), DHW 50 degC as 50 degF (10 degC). The read path setpoint_check._setpoint_and_unit already falls back to hass.config.units.temperature_unit; the write path does not.

evidence.unit: cells of 6 (degF arm); null degC arm 0 of 6

perturbation.change: --perturb: patch pump_arbiter.state_unit to fall back to hass.config.units.temperature_unit for a unit-less state

findings.metric_definition: Cells (slot x surface domain x unit system) where the value in the captured service-call payload, read back by setpoint_check._read_setpoint, differs from the intended degC by more than 0.5
findings.phenomenon_property: Every set-point write to an entity without unit_of_measurement must convert from degC using the instance unit system, as the read path does
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Resolve the write unit in pump_arbiter._write with the same fallback _setpoint_and_unit uses (instance temperature_unit for climate/unit-less states)

non_findings.claim: number and input_number set-point surfaces deliver the intended degC under both degC and degF instances
climate surface on a Celsius instance (null control) delivers correctly

findings.title: pre-edit hook lets a MultiEdit write a RELEASE_NOTES version heading off main
findings.claim: The pre-edit hook checks only top-level new_string/content/new_source, so a MultiEdit whose edits[*].new_string adds a '## ' heading to RELEASE_NOTES.md on a non-main branch exits 0. The same text through Edit exits 2.

perturbation.change: also append edits[*].new_string to the text the RELEASE_NOTES branch inspects (harness --perturb)

findings.metric_definition: Count of probe payloads writing a new '## ' heading into RELEASE_NOTES.md off main that the real hook script exits 0 on
findings.phenomenon_property: A content-inspecting refusal in the hook reads only the fields of some of the tool shapes its matcher admits
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Flatten tool_input.edits[*].new_string into the inspected text, and add a MultiEdit refuse case to --self-test
